start_policy: Explicit later launch; keep stopped experiments and simulations stopped

sampling.legacy_centers: Reuse only exact lineage/trajectory-matched outcome-independent 64-center selections; otherwise sample uniformly before labels
sampling.native_anchors: 16 evenly spaced integer indices in the matched origin grid, never selected by outcomes
sampling.test_policy: Exploratory inherited sources; outcomes do not select cohorts, checkpoints, hyperparameters, time budgets or extension jobs
sampling.census_policy: Label the preselected 16 core centers first; reuse verified legacy 64-center labels where available; expand census to 64 only without delaying core results
sampling.empty_source_policy: Report sources with no eligible at-risk rows by fold and temperature; normalize event metrics over eligible sources only; physical all-state cohort remains unchanged

assay.event: First sustained local episode at the tracked atom; start of run, not confirmation time
assay.population_weighting: Equal source weight; natural eligible-window prevalence within each source
assay.nearby_crystal_policy: Requires PTM labels for all neighbors inside 25 A at audited origins; otherwise report stratum unavailable, never infer absence from sampled centers
assay.nearby_crystal_definition: Any PTM-crystalline neighbor other than the center within 25 A; report neighbor count/fraction too; this is context stratification, not a nucleation label

descriptors.normalization: Train-only; no crystal label or future-derived feature in forecasting inputs
descriptors.auxiliary_observation_policy: Center-feature and shell comparisons require validated producers; unresolved definitions are blocked jobs, not silent replacement features

native.warm_start: One newly trained xv snapshot parent per objective/seed; all three children, including snapshot continuation, receive the same additional K updates
native.choose_budget: Largest shared K fitting both workers' single-seed groups within the first-result target, using measured p90 training, validation and export costs; freeze before core fits
native.physical_future_head: Linear z+condition to six conditional means, no mixture/covariance head
native.supervised_head: Six-bin discrete hazard, no crystal labels in general-encoder loss
native.dtype: FP32 reference; any faster execution needs output/gradient validation before freezing
native.sampler: Uniform train source, then uniform eligible row within source; no event enrichment
native.physical_selection: Equal mean standardized future MSE across six lags; present and per-block errors are gates/diagnostics
native.supervised_selection: Source-weighted event-time negative log likelihood on selection sources

phases.local_h100: Reproduce frozen positive control; identity/split audit; freeze centers and window plan
phases.remote_h200: Verify uploaded sources; implement/test batched simple-head/gated-history pathway; tiny train-only fit/profile

phases.local_h100: Coverage, corrected assay, 16-center dense descriptor release, current/future observability audit
phases.remote_h200: Prepare matched raw-window index and bounded graph cache; train-only fitting checks; exchange release identities

phases.local_h100: Descriptor event/physical baselines; calibrate/check signal; freeze shared K
phases.remote_h200: If gates pass, start physical-mean parent plus matched triplet for seed 20260919

phases.local_h100: Supervised-onset parent plus matched triplet for seed 20260919
phases.remote_h200: Finish physical-mean triplet, frozen-state physical and event diagnostics; publish immediately when complete

phases.local_h100: Natural-population metrics, event alarms, calibration and source intervals; publish first complete report
phases.remote_h200: Return core artifacts/code; no extra fits solely to fill the allocation

phases.local_h100: Contingency for core preparation/evaluation overruns; optional extensions only after core report
phases.remote_h200: Contingency for core preparation/evaluation overruns; optional extensions only after core report

phases.local_h100: Hard checkpoint/package reserve; finish earlier whenever possible
phases.remote_h200: Hard checkpoint/package reserve; finish earlier whenever possible

gates.source_integrity: Exact manifests/arrays, 150 unique lineages, original 90/30/30 folds, full 0--600 ps cadence; legacy reproduction keeps its own 74/24/27 folds
gates.assay_integrity: Finite patch/full-cell PTM agreement; censor/endpoint tests; future-leakage and split tests; reproducible legacy scores
gates.coverage: On train/validation only: at least 20 event-bearing train lineages, 5 in selection and 5 in calibration, and 50 distinct center episodes in each validation half for the primary matched population; otherwise coverage-limited
gates.nested_initialization: Gates off reproduces parent current-state outputs and shared gradients; gates have finite nonzero learning signal
gates.small_set_fit: Train-only 32-window present-information fit reaches declared average and block errors; diagnose before generalizing if it fails
gates.budget_feasible: Both workers can finish each reserved matched group, final evaluation and one-hour checkpoint reserve using measured costs
gates.demonstrated_signal: Validation improvement over condition-only reference at a primary horizon on log loss and Brier; report source intervals conditional on the single training seed; failure does not establish zero physical signal
gates.mean_prediction_competence: Physical native mean or frozen-z ridge is within 5% of current-packet ridge validation MSE on identical observations; no material single-block failure hidden by the mean

optional_priority: Finish missing member of an already launched core matched group
Native H48 plus separately trained repeat48, with equal-budget snapshot continuation; one objective only
One wider-radius snapshot/history comparison if descriptor-shell results warrant it
Existing shooting-family ensemble audit; three completed precision-training-source numerical audit if already present
prohibited_automatic_work: mix NPT and Langevin shooting kernels
reinterpret incomplete fits as full comparisons
outputs: frozen metric definitions and implementation hashes
